questions.question: A patient develops increased circulating thyroxine levels. Subsequently, TSH secretion decreases because of hormonal feedback. Which type of feedback explains this finding?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Direct negative feedback

questions.question: A patient experiences sleep disturbances after disruption of the normal pineal gland function. Which hormone is primarily responsible for regulating the circadian rhythm?
During childbirth, stretching of the cervix stimulates hypothalamic nuclei and increases uterine contractions. Which hormone mediates this positive feedback mechanism?
Which hormone inhibits growth hormone secretion?
Which of the following stimulates GH secretion?
Prolactin inhibits ovulation by which of the following?
options: Blocking gonadotropic hormone effects on ovaries
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Blocking gonadotropic hormone effects on ovaries

questions.question: Thyroid hormone receptor alpha is responsible mainly for which of the following?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. General metabolic functions

questions.question: A 60-year-old patient experiences severe hemorrhage, resulting in decreased blood circulating volume. Which hormonal response helps restore extracellular fluid volume?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Increased ADH secretion

questions.question: A patient develops increased ADH secretion, which subsequently stimulates ACTH release from the anterior pituitary. Which receptor mediates this pituitary action?
A patient develops increased thyroid hormone levels with increased peripheral vasodilation. Which blood pressure is most likely to change?
options: Increased systolic and decreased diastolic pressure
Decreased systolic and increased diastolic pressure
Increased systolic and increased diastolic pressure
Decreased systolic and decreased diastolic pressure
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Increased systolic and decreased diastolic pressure
